description: This file contains the CustomerGroup controller class for the OpenCart admin panel that manages events related to customer groups. It includes methods for adding, editing, and deleting customer groups, and it enqueues tasks to be processed after these operations.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class that handles event-driven operations for customer groups in the admin panel, triggering task creation after add, edit, or delete actions.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to generate new customer group data after a customer group has been added.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to generate updated customer group data after a customer group has been edited.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Adds tasks to handle customer group deletion events.
